description:
Search jobs on Indeed that match your resume and career goals, with Indeed for ChatGPT.

Connect your Indeed profile to search for job opportunities based on your resume, skills, and career history. View job details and company insights without ever leaving the chat.

With Indeed in the conversation you can:
Search for jobs using your Indeed profile
View details for specific jobs
Learn more about potential employers

Tap apply to take the next steps on Indeed.

defaultPrompt: find me data scientist roles in New York City
find me jobs that fit my work experience
